about: Breaks of the island-rebuilt refusal (docs/islands.md 13.1): each must be caught by a check that fails on its own.

breaks.name: the program is not checked for rebuilt islands
an island under an If or a For is not noticed
an island in a component that is not mounted is not noticed
the frames of the HTML are not counted
the message does not say what to do
breaks.from: Put the instance in the mounted component, outside every `If` and `For`, and pass what changes as props from that component's state
